WITH high_risk_traders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t."TR_KEY"
    FROM traders t
    JOIN trade_records tr ON tr."tr_anchor" = t."TR_KEY"
    WHERE tr."freq_tag" = 'High'
    AND (
        (tr."trade_perf"->>'lev_ratio' IS NOT NULL 
         AND CAST(tr."trade_perf"->>'lev_ratio' AS numeric) > 5.0
         AND t."trader_fin_data"->>'risk_lvl' = 'Aggressive')
        OR (
            tr."vol_day" / NULLIF(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(t."trader_fin_data"->>'usd_bal', '$', ''), ',', '') AS numeric), 0) > 0.5
        )
    )
),
significant_enforcement AS (
    SELECT e."REC_ENF", e."enf_actions"->>'pen_amt' AS pen_amt, e."act_taken", e."biz_restrict"
    FROM enforcement_actions e
    WHERE e."enf_actions"->>'pen_flag' IN ('Fine', 'Ban')
       OR e."act_taken" = 'Suspension'
       OR e."biz_restrict" = 'Full'
),
financially_impactful AS (
    SELECT se."REC_ENF", se."act_taken"
    FROM significant_enforcement se
    JOIN trade_records tr ON se."REC_ENF" = tr."REC_KEY"
    JOIN traders t ON tr."tr_anchor" = t."TR_KEY"
    WHERE CAST(se."pen_amt" AS numeric) / NULLIF(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(t."trader_fin_data"->>'usd_bal', '$', ''), ',', '') AS numeric), 0) > 0.1
),
costly_hfr AS (
    SELECT fi."REC_ENF", fi."act_taken"
    FROM financially_impactful fi
    JOIN high_risk_traders hrt ON EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM trade_records tr2 
        WHERE tr2."REC_KEY" = fi."REC_ENF" 
        AND tr2."tr_anchor" = hrt."TR_KEY"
    )
)
SELECT "REC_ENF" AS case_id, "act_taken" AS restriction_type
FROM costly_hfr;

    JOIN high_risk_traders hrt ON tr."tr_anchor" = hrt."TR_KEY"
    JOIN traders t ON tr."tr_anchor" = t."TR_KEY"
    WHERE e."enf_actions"->>'pen_flag' IN ('Fine', 'Ban')
       OR e."act_taken" = 'Suspension'
       OR e."biz_restrict" = 'Full'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "REC_ENF") FROM efir_calc WHERE efir > 0.3;
SELECT "REC_ENF", COUNT(*) FROM enforcement_actions GROUP BY "REC_ENF" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 LIMIT 5;

-- Clean approach: each enforcement action maps to one trade_record -> one trader
-- Check if the trader for that specific trade_record is high-risk and high-frequency
WITH trader_high_freq AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT tr."tr_anchor" AS TR_KEY
    FROM trade_records tr
    WHERE tr."freq_tag" = 'High'
),
high_risk_traders AS (
    SELECT t."TR_KEY"
    FROM traders t
    JOIN trader_high_freq thf ON thf.TR_KEY = t."TR_KEY"
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM trade_records tr2 
        WHERE tr2."tr_anchor" = t."TR_KEY"
        AND (
            (tr2."trade_perf"->>'lev_ratio' IS NOT NULL 
             AND CAST(tr2."trade_perf"->>'lev_ratio' AS numeric) > 5.0
             AND t."trader_fin_data"->>'risk_lvl' = 'Aggressive')
            OR (CAST(REPLACE(tr2."bal_turnover", ' times/day', '') AS numeric) > 0.5)
        )
    )
),
enforcement_with_efir AS (
    SELECT e."REC_ENF", e."act_taken",
           CAST(e."enf_actions"->>'pen_amt' AS numeric) / NULLIF(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(t."trader_fin_data"->>'usd_bal', '$', ''), ',', '') AS numeric), 0) AS efir
    FROM enforcement_actions e
    JOIN trade_records tr ON e."REC_ENF" = tr."REC_KEY"
    JOIN traders t ON tr."tr_anchor" = t."TR_KEY"
    WHERE e."enf_actions"->>'pen_flag' IN ('Fine', 'Ban')
       OR e."act_taken" = 'Suspension'
       OR e."biz_restrict" = 'Full'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM enforcement_with_efir efe
JOIN high_risk_traders hrt ON EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM trade_records tr3 
    WHERE tr3."REC_KEY" = efe."REC_ENF" 
    AND tr3."tr_anchor" = hrt."TR_KEY"
)
WHERE efe.efir > 0.1;
